policy.timestamp_rule: If an exact market-public timestamp is not independently verified, the event becomes usable only from the next NSE session open at 09:15 IST.
policy.direction_rule: Direction is assigned only when the event itself has an unambiguous directional interpretation; ambiguous strategic, administrative, or results-without-quantified-surprise events are NEUTRAL.

events.title: RBI keeps repo rate at 5.25% and maintains neutral stance
events.notes: Event predates the frozen replay window; retained as recent macro context only.

events.title: State Bank of India Q1 FY27 results board outcome
events.notes: Board meeting concluded on 7 Aug. Conservative next-session-open timestamp avoids assuming an earlier dissemination time; no directional surprise score is inferred from later price.

events.notes: Company disclosure is dated 17 Aug; effective next session open because exact exchange broadcast timestamp was not frozen. The disclosed court outcome was favorable, so direction is intrinsic to the event rather than inferred from price.
